definition: [ מָחַק ] verb utterly destroy, annihilate (compare GFM ) (Late Hebrew id. wipe or rub of, erase; , Aramaic מְחַק id. ; Arabic utterly destroy, annihilate) ; — only 3 feminine singular: מָֽחֲקָה ראֹשׁוֺ Judg 5:26 (|| הָלַם , מָחַץ , חָלַף ). [ מֶחְקָר ] see חקר .
